title: Tesla’s ‘Full Self-Driving’ Becomes ‘Assisted Driving’ in Europe
description: The automaker has been criticized for misleading drivers with the feature’s name. Now it’s renaming it for European regulators.

keyPoints: Tesla is renaming its 'Full Self-Driving' feature for European regulators.

This change follows criticism that the previous name was misleading to drivers.
